Title: What is a Hand strike anyway?

Messages.Author: faust
Messages.Body:
I just began to use potence and was reading "Immortal Grapple".
So what is a hand strike?
Is "Undead strenght" considered a hand strike?
How about burning wrath?

also..the dominate card "Thoughts Betrayed"
At superior level, the opponent cannot play cards until end of
combat...which is what?
a round of comabt or the whole duration?

Thanks in advance for answering my silly questions.

Messages.Author: LSJ (VtES Rep)
Messages.Body:
faust wrote:
>
> I just began to use potence and was reading "Immortal Grapple".
> So what is a hand strike?

Hand Strike - any non-ranged, non-weapon strike that deals damage based
on the striking minion's hand damage. Also, any minion's non-ranged
damage-dealing innate strike.

> Is "Undead strength" considered a hand strike?
> How about burning wrath?

Yes and yes.

> also..the dominate card "Thoughts Betrayed"
> At superior level, the opponent cannot play cards until end of
> combat...which is what?
> a round of comabt or the whole duration?

Until the end of combat. For the whole duration of combat.

--

Messages.Author: LSJ (VtES Rep)
Messages.Body:
LSJ (VtES Rep) wrote:
>
> faust wrote:
> >
> > I just began to use potence and was reading "Immortal Grapple".
> > So what is a hand strike?
>
> Hand Strike - any non-ranged, non-weapon strike that deals damage based
> on the striking minion's hand damage. Also, any minion's non-ranged
> damage-dealing innate strike.
>
> > Is "Undead strength" considered a hand strike?
> > How about burning wrath?
>
> Yes and yes.

To be complete: Undead Strength is a hand strike if you're executing
the first form of the strike: "use your hand at +1/+2 damage".

If you use the second form ("use your melee weapon at +1/+2 damage"),
then the strike is not a hand strike.
